evidence.title: An enzymatic activation of formaldehyde for nucleotide methylation
evidence.boundary: 엽산이 탄소와 수소화물을 직접 공급하는 ThyA와 달리 플라빈 N5가 공유 탄소 운반체·환원체를 겸하고 기질 활성화에도 시스테인 부가가 필요하지 않다. 당 고리 전환의 아노머 치환과도 다르다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: formaldehyde reacts with the reduced flavin coenzyme to form a carbinolamine intermediate
evidence.limits: 2021 structure and competent formaldehyde shunt establish N5-carbinolamine chemistry; do not claim the shunt is the physiological carbon supply. The paper explicitly allows equilibrium with a possible iminium electrophile. FAD-CH2-dUMP bridge and hydride sequence are a supported mechanistic model, not every transition directly observed.

supplementary.finding: 2016 Science, An unprecedented mechanism of nucleotide methylation in organisms containing thyX, DOI 10.1126/science.aad0300: quenched derivatives support flavin-mediated methylene relay.

evidence.body_sections: 2021 Results: A flavin carbinolamine sustains ThyX activity; Structural capture; Flavin carbinolamine as a bona fide methylene donor; Discussion.

evidence.title: Organometallic and radical intermediates reveal mechanism of diphthamide biosynthesis
evidence.boundary: 아데노실 라디칼을 수소 제거 개시자로 쓰는 경로와 달리 다른 SAM 결합의 절단 조각 자체가 기질에 편입된다. 메틸시스테인 운반체의 탈수소화·효소 가교 해소도 거치지 않는다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: the radical incorporates the ACP group of SAM
evidence.limits: 2018 isotope-sensitive EPR/ENDOR and product timing support ACP addition to histidine, with an upstream cluster-associated intermediate assigned as organometallic. The article itself retains alternative cleavage electron sequences. Later institutional dissertations challenge the Fe-C assignment computationally; this row therefore does not require Fe-C structure as an established fact.

supplementary.finding: 2022 Donnan dissertation proposes a SAM near-attack-conformer alternative; non-journal computational interpretation used only to retain uncertainty, not as affirmative row evidence.
2025 Martz institutional dissertation extends the alternative spectroscopic assignments. Not treated as a peer-reviewed resolution.

evidence.body_sections: Opened official author-hosted PDF, especially isotope assignment and time-course pages 2–3, proposed mechanism page 4.

evidence.title: Enantiomeric Free Radicals and Enzymatic Control of Stereochemistry in a Radical Mechanism: The Case of Lysine 2,3-Aminomutases
evidence.boundary: PLP 이민과 라디칼이 협동하여 같은 분자 안에서 C–N 연결 위치를 바꾸는 경로다. 분자 사이 질소 교환이나 코발트 결합 절단 자체와 구별하며 SAM·코발라민 개시 및 이동 위치별로 나누지 않는다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: the basic chemistry is the same for the two enzymes, but the stereochemistry is different
evidence.limits: 2006 primary comparative isotope/EPR work observes substrate-analogue and product-related radicals. The azacyclopropylcarbinyl intermediate is a mechanistic proposal; native transient substrate and three-membered-ring radicals are not all directly observed. Combine SAM- and cobalamin-initiated PLP aminomutases and positional/stereochemical variants.

supplementary.finding: 2005 primary X-ray structure shows PLP-lysyl external aldimine positioned for radical hydrogen abstraction; opened PMC returned CAPTCHA, not full access.

2022 primary cofactor-analogue study, DOI 10.3390/ijms23095210, supports PLP nitrogen participation and shared radical-amino-shift mechanism; no analogue preparation or enzyme engineering details reproduced.

evidence.title: Interplay of nucleophilic catalysis with proton transfer in the nitrile reductase QueF from Escherichia coli
evidence.boundary: 니트릴 수소화의 구체적 공유 촉매 경로로 티오이미데이트·헤미티오아미날·차폐 이민을 거친다. 니트릴분해효소와 초기 부가는 공유하지만 물에 의한 질소 제거 대신 두 번 환원하고 질소를 보존한다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: The imine is sequestered effectively in the QueF active site to prevent its decomposition.
evidence.limits: 2019 primary proton-transfer study read in full. Initial cysteinyl thioimidate is shared with nitrilase but its two NADPH reduction steps and retained imine nitrogen differ from hydrolysis. Individual proton-relay assignments and hemithioaminal are mechanistic interpretations supported by earlier structures/kinetics, not all trapped species.

supplementary.finding: 2012 Structural Basis of Biological Nitrile Reduction: crystallographic thioimide adduct and substrate-induced closure.
2016 kinetic study: two 4-pro-R hydride transfers; thioimide trapping precedes slower reductions.
2017 Evidence of a sequestered imine intermediate... DOI 10.1074/jbc.M117.804583: imine exposure gives aldehyde, supporting protective sequestration.

evidence.body_sections: Opened RSC Abstract, Introduction and Results/Discussion around proton-transfer and competing direct-reduction alternatives.

evidence.title: Order–Disorder Transitions Govern Kinetic Cooperativity and Allostery of Monomeric Human Glucokinase
evidence.boundary: 다른 조절 자리의 리간드 결합이나 결합 분자의 느린 해리 대신 기질이 떠난 뒤 남는 효소 구조의 수명과 재결합 경쟁이 핵심이다. 평형 결합 협동성 없이 비평형 반응 경로의 분배가 변한다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: ordered unliganded GCK persists until, on the millisecond time scale, the small domain undergoes an order–disorder transition
evidence.limits: 2012 NMR supports a delay-loop model; later 2015 exchange-rate data substantiate competition between structural exchange and turnover. Keep a general kinetic-competition statement rather than claim one exact number of microscopic states or universal resonance law. No clinical/therapeutic recommendation.

supplementary.finding: 2015 primary CPMG NMR detects glucose-free conformer exchange on the turnover timescale; glucose quenches exchange. Published title Kinetic Cooperativity in Human Pancreatic Glucokinase Originates from Millisecond Dynamics of the Small Domain; PMC manuscript title differs.
Publisher search abstract for the 2015 primary study; direct open returned 403.

evidence.body_sections: Opened PLOS full text, Introduction and Discussion/Figure 3 time-delay-loop model.

evidence.title: Biosynthetic Versatility and Coordinated Action of 5′-Deoxyadenosyl Radicals in Deazaflavin Biosynthesis
evidence.boundary: 아미노산 절단의 작은 조각을 금속 리간드로 쓰는 경로와 달리 벤질 조각을 분자 간 부가한 뒤 별도 라디칼 개시로 융합 고리를 닫는다. 단일 당·염기 내부 고리화와 다르며 두 효소형을 나누지 않는다.
evidence.retrieved_excerpt: it was possible to trap 9, the product of the CofH-catalyzed reaction
evidence.limits: 2015 isotope-label transfer, coproduct characterization, and isolated intermediate turnover support two sequential radical stages. Fragmentation starts from a proposed amino H abstraction; benzyl-radical scrambling supports but does not directly image the short-lived radical. CofG final cyclization microsteps remain modeled. Do not split two domains, species or F420 uses.

supplementary.finding: Primary abstract independently confirms two separately generated radicals, characterized CofH product and its competence as CofG substrate.
Primary publisher indexed body confirms exchangeable H abstraction precedes the nonexchangeable H abstraction. Direct open failed; scope remains search excerpt.

evidence.title: A pentacyclic reaction intermediate of riboflavin synthase
evidence.boundary: 단순 고리첨가 산물 유지나 수소화물만의 불균등화와 달리 실측 공유 이합체의 분해로 네 탄소 단위를 두 기질 사이에 재배분한다. 효소 라이신에 고정된 분자 내부 탄소 삽입과도 다르다.
evidence.limits: 2001 isotope NMR identifies a pentacyclic covalent dimer and kinetic conversion supports its role. Four-carbon transfer is established. Formation through a protein nucleophile versus hydride transfer followed by cycloaddition remains unresolved; no obligatory concerted Diels–Alder claim. Archaeal/bacterial stereoisomers are not separate cards.

supplementary.finding: 2010 primary NMR binds exomethylene anion; explicitly proposes an alternative hydride/cycloaddition mechanism and notes missing evidence for obligatory protein nucleophile.
2005 primary pre-steady-state analysis uses the isolated pentacycle and supports forward/backward conversion with additional inferred intermediate.
2005 primary comparison finds stereochemical variants of the same pentacyclic pathway; do not count them independently.

evidence.body_sections: Opened PNAS full article: isotope NMR structure, kinetic competence and explicitly speculative full sequence.

excluded_or_held.reason: 2016 primary evidence supports large CD45 ectodomain exclusion and local kinase/phosphatase balance. Under strict identity criterion this can be interpreted as size exclusion applied to receptor signaling, with no new physical sorting mechanism beyond pore/gap exclusion. Do not count merely the downstream signaling output.

Primary MAT structure supports methionine sulfur attack at ATP C5 and triphosphate handling. Carbon SN2 plus known phosphate cleavage appears a combination/application, insufficient independent pathway for this batch.

Discovery review states anti-1,4 elimination is stepwise and flavin role has competing mechanisms. General elimination is already present and primary evidence has not resolved a sufficiently independent pathway here. Review is not accepted affirmative evidence.
2009 primary work supports reduced flavin acid-base role without redox. Changing the proton-shuttling cofactor alone does not justify a new alkene-isomerization card.
Competing ring-cleavage and azacyclopropyl paths; overlap with radical PLP migration/ring remodelling too uncertain for an additional count.

excluded_or_held.decision: combine into one PLP radical amino-migration card
excluded_or_held.reason: SAM versus cobalamin initiation, alpha/beta versus more remote positions, or product enantiomer do not split the downstream PLP-linked radical amino-shift pathway.
2005 primary comparison confirms the same pentacyclic constitution with changed stereochemistry. Organism and diastereomer are not independent mechanisms.
